combinations.title: High blood pressure with chest pain
possible_explanations: May be related to a severe blood-pressure rise that needs urgent medical assessment.
actions: Start the approved medical emergency protocol.
Contact the ground flight surgeon now.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Blood pressure, RED: 'severe blood pressure elevation occurs with chest pain, shortness of breath, severe headache, visual disturbances, confusion' | https://www.nasa.gov/reference/risk-of-cardiovascular-adaptations/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25774397/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41390616/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30189994/

combinations.title: High blood pressure with breathing difficulty
possible_explanations: May be related to a severe blood-pressure rise that needs urgent medical assessment.
actions: Start the approved medical emergency protocol.
Contact the ground flight surgeon now.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Blood pressure, RED: 'severe blood pressure elevation occurs with chest pain, shortness of breath' | https://www.nasa.gov/reference/risk-of-cardiovascular-adaptations/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25774397/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41390616/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30189994/

combinations.title: Low blood pressure with fainting
possible_explanations: May be related to circulatory instability; fluid shifts in microgravity can lower blood pressure.
actions: Lie down and repeat the measurement when safe.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Blood pressure, RED: 'very low blood pressure is accompanied by fainting, severe dizziness, or signs of circulatory instability' | https://www.nasa.gov/reference/risk-of-cardiovascular-adaptations/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25774397/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41390616/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30189994/

combinations.title: Unusual heart rate with chest pain
possible_explanations: May be related to a heart-rhythm or circulation problem that needs immediate assessment.
actions: Contact the ground flight surgeon now.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Heart rate, RED: 'abnormal heart rate is accompanied by chest pain, fainting, severe dizziness, or shortness of breath' | https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/iss-research/nasa-shares-station-research-today-supporting-moon-mars-tomorrow/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41027905/; https://www.jacc.org/doi/10.1016/j.jacc.2023.05.058

combinations.title: Unusual heart rate with fainting or severe dizziness
possible_explanations: May be related to a heart-rhythm problem that needs immediate assessment.
actions: Lie down and stay with a crewmate.
Contact the ground flight surgeon now.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Heart rate, RED: 'abnormal heart rate is accompanied by chest pain, fainting, severe dizziness' | https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/iss-research/nasa-shares-station-research-today-supporting-moon-mars-tomorrow/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41027905/; https://www.jacc.org/doi/10.1016/j.jacc.2023.05.058

combinations.title: Unusual heart rate with breathing difficulty
possible_explanations: May be related to a heart or lung problem that needs immediate assessment.
actions: Contact the ground flight surgeon now.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Heart rate, RED: 'abnormal heart rate is accompanied by ... shortness of breath' | https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/iss-research/nasa-shares-station-research-today-supporting-moon-mars-tomorrow/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41027905/; https://www.jacc.org/doi/10.1016/j.jacc.2023.05.058

combinations.title: Low blood sugar with symptoms
possible_explanations: May be related to low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia).
actions: If conscious and able to swallow, take fast-acting glucose per protocol.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Blood sugar, YELLOW: 'below 70 mg/dL ... symptoms such as sweating, shakiness, hunger, unusual fatigue, or dizziness' | https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/human_adaptation_2021_final.pdf; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36224737/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41358894/

combinations.title: High blood sugar with suspected ketones
possible_explanations: May be related to a possible hyperglycaemic crisis.
actions: Check blood or urine ketones if available.
Contact the ground flight surgeon now.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Blood sugar, RED: 'persistently elevated above 200 mg/dL together with symptoms or suspected ketones' | https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/human_adaptation_2021_final.pdf; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36224737/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41358894/

combinations.title: High blood sugar with vomiting, thirst or dehydration
possible_explanations: May be related to a possible hyperglycaemic crisis.
actions: Contact the ground flight surgeon now.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Blood sugar, RED: 'vomiting, dehydration, abdominal pain, excessive thirst, or altered mental status suggest a possible hyperglycemic crisis' | https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/human_adaptation_2021_final.pdf; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36224737/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41358894/

combinations.title: Raised temperature with chills
possible_explanations: May be related to an infection or another cause of fever.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Body temperature, RED: 'fever with chills, confusion, severe headache, rash or breathing difficulty' | https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5701078/; https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/heat-safety-in-space-keeps-infants-and-patients-safe-on-earth/; https://www.nasa.gov/help-nasa-find-practical-ways-to-monitor-astronaut-body-temperature-in-low-earth-orbit/

combinations.title: Raised temperature with infection symptoms
possible_explanations: May be related to an infection; latent viruses can reactivate in spaceflight.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Immune signs / symptoms, RED: 'temperature reaches higher, particularly with other infection symptoms' | https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/esdmd/hhp/immune-risk/; https://www.nasa.gov/humans-in-space/nasa-investigates-how-dormant-viruses-behave-during-spaceflight/; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5701078/; https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/heat-safety-in-space-keeps-infants-and-patients-safe-on-earth/; https://www.nasa.gov/help-nasa-find-practical-ways-to-monitor-astronaut-body-temperature-in-low-earth-orbit/

combinations.title: Body-mass loss with weakness
possible_explanations: May be related to too little food or fluid intake, or to muscle loss in microgravity.
actions: Review food and fluid intake and exercise.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Body mass, RED: 'body-mass loss of approximately 5% or more accompanied by continued decline, weakness, dizziness' | https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25197887/; https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/esdmd/hhp/food-and-nutrition-risk/; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/human-adaptation-2021-final-b.pdf

combinations.title: Short sleep and lower mood
possible_explanations: Sleep loss may be related to lower mood, anxiety and morale.
actions: Keep social contact with the crew and family.
Tell your crew medical officer if it continues.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Sleep hours, hazards: 'sleep loss can lead to depressive symptoms, anxiety and lower mood and morale'; Mood, hazards: 'disrupted sleep can negatively affect emotional well-being' | https://doi.org/10.1016/S1474-4422(14)70122-X; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/sleep-accomodations-technical-brief-ochmo.pdf; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4434546/; https://www.nasa.gov/reference/6-0-medical-operations/; https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20250001454; https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-07648-x

combinations.title: Short sleep and immune symptoms
possible_explanations: Disrupted sleep and stress may be related to weaker immune function.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Immune signs / symptoms, hazards: 'psychological stress and disrupted sleep can affect immune function' | https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/esdmd/hhp/immune-risk/; https://www.nasa.gov/humans-in-space/nasa-investigates-how-dormant-viruses-behave-during-spaceflight/; https://doi.org/10.1016/S1474-4422(14)70122-X; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/sleep-accomodations-technical-brief-ochmo.pdf; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4434546/

combinations.title: Radiation event with skin changes
possible_explanations: Skin redness after a radiation event may be related to the exposure and needs medical evaluation.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Radiation dose, RED: 'assess possible exposure-related symptoms and arrange medical evaluation' | https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/hazard-space-radiation/; https://www.nasa.gov/reference/4-0-human-performance/; https://srag.jsc.nasa.gov/spaceradiation/faq/faq.cfm; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/2022-01-05_nasa-std-3001_vol.1_rev._b_final_draft_with_signature_010522.pdf; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34058745/; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9604750/; https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0738081X25002858

combinations.title: Spreading skin redness with raised temperature
possible_explanations: May be related to a potentially serious skin infection.
actions: Mark the edge of the redness and photograph it.
combinations.source: Health_Indicators_Research table v5 — Skin health, RED: 'rapidly spreading redness, increasing warmth or swelling, pus, red streaks around a wound, fever' | https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34058745/; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9604750/; https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0738081X25002858
